title: check says a check that a file was removed can never pass once the file is gone
goal: gone_path_warnings (ST-huye4kew) does not warn of a path a check asserts is absent (a python -c on Path(...).exists() that exits non-zero on it, test ! -e, os.path.exists negated), so a removal item is not told to drop itself once its work removed the file. Found by the SP-3rzxx3m4 review.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_check as c;sys.exit(1 if c.command_paths(['python3','-c','import pathlib,sys; sys.exit(pathlib.Path("_tools/kbold.py").exists())']) else 0)
